questions.topic: DAMS · Prevention of Non communicable disease
questions.stem: Which one of the following statements about influence of smoking on risk of coronary heart disease (CHD) is not true?

options.label: A
options.text: Risk of death from CHD decreases from cessation of smoking

options.label: B
options.text: Filters in cigarette provide a protective effect for CHD

options.label: C
options.text: Influence of smoking is synergistic to other risk factors for CHD

options.label: D
options.text: Influence of smoking is directly related to number of cigarettes smoked per day
